## Product research

- Current v1.0.31 `docs/agents.md` confirms Cursor uses the agent-native session path rather than `record` / `debug trace`, and documents `agentsight top`, `agentsight report --local`, and `agentsight vis` as Cursor workflows.
- Current `ext/analysis/src/sources/agent_native.rs` checks Cursor state databases under macOS `Library/Application Support`, Linux `.config`, and Windows `AppData/Roaming`, opens the database read-only, and enriches matching sessions.
- The same source sums `inputTokens` and `outputTokens` from matching Cursor bubble records and rolls in discovered delegated subagent IDs before attaching non-zero usage to the session. This is more current than the older website wording that recent Cursor sessions necessarily lack token totals.
- Current parser and repository-replay source preserve delegated `subagents/*.jsonl` work as part of the parent session and include Cursor candidates in repository replay.
